days.title: VS Code & Python Environment Setup
objectives: Install VS Code and Python on your machine
Configure the Python extension and Pylance
Create and activate a project virtual environment (.venv)
Run and debug your first Python program inside VS Code

days.title: Local LLM & AI Coding Assistant Setup
objectives: Install Ollama and download a local coding model
Verify the local model works through the Ollama CLI

days.title: First AI Project, React Frontend & GitHub
objectives: Build a command-line chatbot powered by your local Ollama model
Scaffold a FastAPI backend with a health endpoint
Create a React application using Vite

days.title: Reading & Processing Structured Data
objectives: Create synthetic healthcare plans and claims datasets
Load and clean structured CSV data using Pandas
Store the processed data in a SQLite database

days.title: Reading & Processing Unstructured Data
objectives: Extract text from healthcare PDFs and Word documents
Perform OCR on scanned enrollment forms

days.title: Building the Knowledge Base
objectives: Convert structured and unstructured healthcare data into a unified knowledge base
Split long documents into retrieval-friendly chunks

days.title: Embeddings Explained
objectives: Understand how text is converted into vector embeddings
Generate embeddings for every knowledge base chunk

days.title: Vector Databases Overview
objectives: Learn the role of vector databases in RAG applications
Set up a local Chroma vector database

days.title: Building & Populating the Vector Database
objectives: Load knowledge base embeddings into the vector database
Store documents together with metadata for filtering

days.title: The Retrieval & Matching Engine
objectives: Build a query router that decides between SQL, vector search, or hybrid retrieval
Implement structured data lookup for plans and claims

days.title: RAG End-to-End & LLM API Basics
objectives: Connect the retrieval engine to an LLM to build a complete RAG pipeline
Create a grounded prompt that answers only from retrieved context

days.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
objectives: Understand zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting
Design multiple system prompt variations for the chatbot

days.title: Advanced Prompting: Function Calling & Structured Outputs
objectives: Define tool schemas for healthcare-related chatbot functions
Implement LLM function calling with automatic tool execution

days.title: Fine-Tuning: Concepts & When to Use It
objectives: Understand when fine-tuning is more appropriate than prompting or RAG
Create a high-quality fine-tuning dataset

days.title: Fine-Tuning: Hands-On with LoRA & QLoRA
objectives: Train or fine-tune an LLM using LoRA or OpenAI fine-tuning workflow
Compare base model and fine-tuned model on unseen test cases

days.title: Chatbot Backend & API Integration
objectives: Create a /chat API endpoint for the healthcare chatbot
Integrate retrieval, function calling, and LLM response generation

days.title: Chatbot Frontend Development
objectives: Build an interactive chat interface for the chatbot
Connect the frontend to the backend chat API

days.title: Full-Stack Integration & Streaming Responses
objectives: Implement real-time streaming responses from the LLM
Display generated tokens incrementally in the chat interface

days.title: Response Formatting & Rich Outputs
objectives: Add citations to chatbot responses using retrieved knowledge
Create structured cards for claims and coverage summaries

days.title: Conversation Memory & Context Management
objectives: Persist conversation history across multiple user sessions
Implement automatic conversation summarization for long chats

days.title: Agentic Frameworks: LangChain Agents & Tool Use
objectives: Convert function-calling workflows into a reasoning agent
Build a ReAct agent capable of selecting the correct tool automatically

days.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
objectives: Create specialized agents for different healthcare domains
Build a router agent that delegates requests to the correct specialist

days.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
objectives: Understand the purpose of the Model Context Protocol
Build an MCP server exposing healthcare chatbot tools

days.title: Agentic Chatbot Integration
objectives: Integrate agents, MCP tools, retrieval, and conversation memory
Implement retries, timeouts, and graceful error handling

days.title: Chatbot Evaluation & Testing
objectives: Create a benchmark dataset covering representative healthcare questions
Evaluate chatbot responses for accuracy, grounding, and consistency

days.title: Performance Optimization & Cost Management
objectives: Measure token usage across the chatbot pipeline
Optimize retrieval and prompt size to reduce latency and cost

days.title: Security, Privacy & Guardrails
objectives: Secure chatbot APIs against unauthorized access
Validate and sanitize user inputs before processing

days.title: Docker & Kubernetes Deployment
objectives: Containerize the chatbot backend and frontend using Docker
Deploy the application to a Kubernetes cluster

days.title: Monitoring, Logging & Observability
objectives: Add structured logging throughout the chatbot pipeline
Monitor API performance and chatbot usage

days.title: Production Readiness & Final Testing
objectives: Perform complete end-to-end testing of the chatbot
Fix production issues discovered during testing

days.title: Capstone Project & Final Demo
objectives: Demonstrate the complete enterprise healthcare chatbot
Showcase retrieval, RAG, agents, MCP, and conversation memory
